Q: Thanks for taking the time to talk with me today. This recording is for our claim file. Can you please state your full
name for the record?
A: Sure. I'd rather keep my name off this one, if that's okay. You already have my claim number.
Q: That's fine. We'll reference the claim nmuber only. Can you walk me through where you were when the collision
happened?
A: I was driving on a two-lane road in Katy, Texas, heading toward a shopping center. It was a normal weekday
afternoon, pretty light traffic.
Q: What were you doing right before impact?
A: I had slowed down because the car ahead of me was turning. The other vehicle came over into my lane. I braked,
but we still met almost head-on. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did the airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. I just felt a hard shove forward and then back against the seat.
Q: Did you get out of the car at the scene?
A: I did, and I felt stiff right away. Within a few hours my lower back was really sore, and by the next morning it was
hard to bend over or sit for long.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same evening and then followed up with my family doctor. They diagnosed a back
strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some physical tehrapy referrals.
Q: Is there anything else about the collision you think is important for the file?
A: Just that I'm trying to keep up with the therapy, and I'd appreciate a call back if you need the medical records.
Thanks.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
